name: 王座倾覆
description: 击败第20层的骷髅王。
english_description: Defeat the Skeleton King on floor 20.

name: 幽魂落幕
description: 击败第20层的幽灵女王。
english_description: Defeat the Ghost Queen on floor 20.

name: 越狱时刻
description: 击败第40层的典狱长。
english_description: Defeat the Warden on floor 40.

name: 折断黑刃
description: 击败第40层的黑暗骑士。
english_description: Defeat the Dark Knight on floor 40.

name: 深海弑神
description: 击败第60层的腐化海洋女神。
english_description: Defeat the Corrupted Ocean Goddess on floor 60.

name: 一段旅途
description: 完成一次远征。
english_description: Finish an expedition.

name: 初露锋芒
description: 首次赢得一场远征战斗。
english_description: Win your first expedition battle.

name: 硬骨头
description: 赢得一场精英战。
english_description: Win an elite battle.

name: 绝处逢生
description: 至少两名角色参战，仅剩一名角色存活时赢得Boss战。
english_description: Enter a boss battle with at least two heroes and win with only one surviving.

name: 一个都不能少
description: 三名角色全部存活，赢得一场Boss战。
english_description: Win a boss battle with all three heroes alive.

name: 算无遗策
description: 同一回合成功应对三张不同的敌方攻击牌。
english_description: Successfully respond to three different enemy attack cards in one turn.

name: 留有余地
description: 携带至少三个消耗品，且不使用任何消耗品，赢得一场Boss战。
english_description: Enter a boss battle with at least three consumables and win without using any.

name: 毒入骨髓
description: 同一场战斗中，让中毒伤害击败至少三名敌人。
english_description: Defeat at least three enemies with poison damage in one battle.

name: 内外交困
description: 击败一名同时拥有中毒和灼烧的敌人。
english_description: Defeat an enemy while it is both poisoned and burning.

name: 一击清场
description: 使用一张攻击牌击败至少三名敌人。
english_description: Defeat at least three enemies with a single attack card.

name: 破阵而入
description: 同一回合内，击败至少一名前排敌人和一名后排敌人。
english_description: Defeat at least one front-row enemy and one back-row enemy in the same turn.

name: 轮番上阵
description: 三名角色各成功应对至少一次敌方攻击，并赢得该场战斗。
english_description: Have all three heroes successfully respond to an enemy attack, then win the battle.

name: 好牌不怕晚
description: 让同一张继承牌连续跨过三个回合结束仍留在手中，随后使用它。
english_description: Keep the same Inherit card in hand through three consecutive turn ends, then play it.

name: 蜕变之物
description: 首次完成一次遗物进化。
english_description: Evolve a relic for the first time.

name: 刻入命运
description: 首次成功刻印一张橙色卡牌。
english_description: Successfully engrave an orange-rarity card.

name: 收藏家
description: 卡牌收藏中拥有至少30种不同的卡牌。
english_description: Own at least 30 different cards in your collection.

name: 橙光闪耀
description: 卡牌收藏中拥有至少五种不同的橙色卡牌。
english_description: Own at least five different orange-rarity cards in your collection.

name: 千锤百炼
description: 将一张可升级卡牌提升至其最高等级。
english_description: Upgrade an upgradable card to its maximum level.

name: 铭刻之路
description: 累计成功刻印五张卡牌。
english_description: Successfully engrave five cards in total.

name: 炉火纯青
description: 将任意一名角色的局外等级提升至满级。
english_description: Raise one hero to the maximum camp level.

name: 群星齐耀
description: 将六名角色的局外等级全部提升至满级。
english_description: Raise all six heroes to the maximum camp level.
